title: NeoOrigins Mob Origin
description: A bundle of powers, spawn rules, and drops attached to a non-player entity. File path: data/<namespace>/origins/mob_origins/<mob_origin>.json. The id field is omitted from the file — MobOriginDataManager injects it from the path.

text.description: Display text — a literal string or a chat-component object (e.g. {"text": "..."} or {"translate": "..."}).

intRange.description: Inclusive integer range. A bare number n is shorthand for {min: n, max: n}.

location.description: Reused LocationCondition — dimension/structure combine with AND, biome fields with OR. Every field is optional.

name.description: Display name shown in the mob-origin browser (never shown in-world).

description.description: Flavor text for the mob-origin browser.

icon.description: Item ID used as the browser icon. String form is shorthand for {item: ...}.

target.description: Which entities this mob origin may roll onto. Set EXACTLY ONE of entity_type, entity_tag, or entity_types.

powers.description: Power IDs granted to a mob carrying this origin. All must resolve to power JSONs under data/<namespace>/origins/powers/.

spawn_rules.description: Weighted, condition-gated rules deciding whether this origin rolls onto a freshly-spawned matching entity.

weight.description: Relative chance this origin is picked at spawn. 0 = never.

spawn_reasons.description: Spawn reasons this origin allows (empty/absent = any). Lowercase MobSpawnType / EntitySpawnReason names.

mutex_group.description: Mutual-exclusion group — origins sharing a group can't co-apply.

replace.description: If true, replaces an already-applied origin instead of being skipped.

y_range.description: Inclusive Y band the spawn must fall within.

light_range.description: Inclusive block-light band the spawn must fall within.

drops.description: Per-origin drop table layered onto (or replacing) the mob's vanilla loot.

mode.description: additive appends to vanilla drops; replace clears them.

strategy.description: independent_chance rolls each entry's chance/rolls; weighted_pool makes pool_rolls weighted picks across entries.

pool_rolls.description: Number of weighted picks (weighted_pool strategy only).

hidden.description: If true, hidden from the mob-origin browser but still valid if applied.
